the Skills tab lists the fixture skills as awaiting review

The Skills tab is offered on a server with enable_skills on and a skills-capable upstream (cmd/skillsfixture, manual trust). The three skills show as Awaiting review and Not offered.

2. Viewer and paging PASS

views SKILL.md, pages a large file, and does not offer a binary file

SKILL.md opens in the text viewer (inert text). A 150 KiB file is read part by part: each Load more waits for its content response and the rendered text, every part carries the digest listed on screen, and the last part has no next_offset. A binary file (logo.bin) is listed as binary, not shown, with no View button.

3. Approve PASS

approve turns the chip to Approved

Approve sends the current_hash and incarnation of the version the reviewer opened; the chip turns Approved.

4. Changed while open, re-open, diff PASS

an upstream change plus Refresh shows Changed with a file diff and a line diff

A mutate without the X-Skills-Fixture header is refused (403). The upstream bytes change while the skill is open; after Refresh the chip says Changed and the open review says it changed while you were reviewing it. Re-opening shows the file-set diff (SKILL.md changed) and the line diff with the added line; approving binds the new hash.

5. Block and unblock PASS

block and unblock

Block marks the skill Blocked and removes Approve; Unblock returns it to Awaiting review.

6. Reload PASS

the tab survives a reload through ?tab=skills and no page error was thrown
